newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer Feb sales off.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer Feb sales off.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said Thursday its Eddie Bauer unit had a four percent drop in same- store sales for the four weeks ended February 22.
Spiegel said the drop reflects a lower level of clearance merchandise available this year compared with last year, due primarily to improved inventories.
For the eight weeks ended February 22, Eddie Bauer's same- store sales were up one percent.
Spiegel said net sales of $160.3 million for the four weeks ended February 22 were down nine percent from sales of $176.5 million a year ago.
Spiegel markets apparel and home furnishings through catalogs, more than 450 specialty retail stores and electronic shopping platforms.
